Times in seconds from the moment the app starts the storyboard (window.__dwts.videoStartMs); before that the app visits every view once so each shot draws from its first frame, and the renderer cuts that warm-up. The page plays no sound in video mode; the renderer mixes the tapped cell's sound offline from app/data/sound.json at tap.t_s, and burns in the captions listed here by id. Step 5 opens on what we trust (drawn from the warm-up) and switches once to the naive difference, which loads unseen at opacity 0 meanwhile; the end card holds the last 2.5 s; the total stays under 30.0 s.
